info.title: SeoSeo API
info.description: Free, open-source SEO platform API. Authenticate with a session cookie (web app) or `Authorization: Bearer seo_…` API key.

post.summary: Create a key bound to the active workspace. The secret is returned once.

get.summary: The issue catalog: ids, severities, explanations and fixes.

post.summary: Create an account (the first account becomes the instance admin) and sign in.

get.summary: Whether sign-up is open and whether the instance still needs its first (admin) account.
Status of the domain authority data (SeoSeo Rank from the Common Crawl web graph).

post.summary:
Import the top domains of the latest Common Crawl web graph (owners). Runs in the
background; follow it with `GET /jobs/{id}`.

get.summary: Instance metadata used by the web app before sign-in.
Public: details of an open invitation (for the invite landing page).

post.summary: Accept an invitation as the signed-in user and switch to that workspace.

get.summary: Recent jobs of the active workspace.

post.summary: Enqueue a no-op job to check the worker is running.

get.summary: The signed-in user, active workspace and role.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: List archived projects instead of active ones.

delete.summary: Permanently delete an archived project and all its data.

post.summary:
Start a crawl of the project's website. Runs in the background; follow progress via
`GET …/audits/{audit_id}` or the `…/events` stream.

get.summary:
Server-sent events: an `audit` event with the audit JSON every second while it runs,
then one final event and the stream closes.
All issues as CSV (url, issue, severity, title, details).
Issue types found, with the number of affected pages.

parameters.name: issue_type
parameters.description: Only pages with this issue type.

get.summary: One crawled page with its issues, outgoing links and inlinks.

post.summary:
Expand a seed keyword into ideas with popularity, intent, and (for the top ideas)
difficulty and SERP features. Runs in the background; poll the research until its status
is `completed`. Metrics that cannot be determined are `null`, never 0.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Only ideas from this source, e.g. `suggest_google`, `related`.

parameters.name: max_kd
parameters.description: Only ideas with a known difficulty at or below this.

parameters.name: min_volume
parameters.description: Only ideas with a known volume estimate at or above this.

get.summary: All ideas of a research as CSV. Empty cells mean "unknown".

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: created_at (default) | keyword | popularity | est_volume | kd | word_count

post.summary: Save ideas of a research (`research_id` + `idea_ids`) or keywords typed by hand.

get.summary: Saved keywords as CSV. Empty cells mean "unknown".
Tags in use on this project's saved keywords.

post.summary:
Results page of a keyword with each domain's authority, SERP features, related searches,
difficulty and intent. Cached pages are reused for 7 days unless `refresh` is set.

get.summary:
Data providers with their status for the active workspace. Free providers are on by
default; API keys are never returned.

put.summary: Switch a provider on or off, or set/remove its API key (admins).

post.summary: Make one small live request to check a provider works (admins).

Invite someone by email. Returns a one-time token for the link `/invite/{token}`;
share it with them (email delivery arrives with SMTP support).

delete.summary: Remove a member (admins), or leave the workspace (yourself). Owners cannot be removed.

prefix.description: First characters of the key, for recognising it in lists.

phase.description: queued | probe | discover | crawl | analyze | done

total_domains.description: Domains in the whole graph (the worst possible rank).

oneOf.description: Running or queued import job, if any (poll `/jobs/{id}` for progress).
Last finished import; null when nothing was imported yet.

domain.description: Root domain, e.g. `example.com`. URLs are accepted and reduced to the host.

secret.description: The full secret. Shown once; store it now.

token.description: Secret token for the invite link (`/invite/{token}`). Shown once.

authority_loaded.description: False until ranks were imported; then a null `sr` means "weaker than every imported domain".

domain.description: Registrable domain that was looked up.

harmonic_rank.description: Position by harmonic centrality in the Common Crawl domain graph.

sr.description: SeoSeo Rank 0–100; null when the domain is outside the imported list.

limit.description: How many top domains to import (1,000–20,000,000; default 1,000,000 ≈ 30 MB download).

est_volume.description: Estimated monthly searches; null when there is no basis for an estimate.

kd.description: Keyword difficulty 0–100; null until a SERP was analysed.

popularity.description: Relative popularity within this research (0–100). Not a search volume.

serp_features.description: Null until a SERP was analysed.

sources.description: Where the idea came from, e.g. `suggest_google`, `suggest_bing`, `related`, `question`.

trend.description: 12 months of `{ month, views }` when a demand signal exists.

warnings.description: Human-readable notes: skipped or rate-limited providers, missing setup.

est_volume.description: Estimated monthly searches; null when there is no basis for an estimate.

kd.description: Keyword difficulty 0–100; null until a SERP was analysed.

popularity.description: Relative popularity within this research (0–100). Not a search volume.

serp_features.description: Null until a SERP was analysed.

sources.description: Where the idea came from, e.g. `suggest_google`, `suggest_bing`, `related`, `question`.

trend.description: 12 months of `{ month, views }` when a demand signal exists.

popularity.description: Relative popularity from the research it was saved from; null for manual entries.

detail.description: Human/agent readable explanation; often tells you what to do next.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the project's default market.

language_code.description: Language of the default market (ISO 639-1, optional region).

needs_env.description: Needs something from the server operator (environment variable).

needs_key.description: Needs an API key from the user.

note.description: Honest note about data quality or terms.

message.description: What happened, phrased for a person.

has_key.description: An API key is stored (the key itself is never returned).

missing.description: What is missing before it can be used.

ready.description: Enabled and fully configured: research will use it.

ids.description: Omit or pass an empty list to refresh all saved keywords. Otherwise 1–1000 IDs.

keywords.description: Or save keywords typed by hand (project market, no metrics yet).

research_id.description: Save ideas of this research (with their metrics)…

already_saved.description: Already saved before, so left unchanged.

popularity.description: Relative popularity from the research it was saved from; null for manual entries.

authority_loaded.description: False until the Common Crawl ranks were imported (KD needs them).

cached.description: Served from the shared SERP cache.

exact.description: True when positions are one search engine's real ranking; false for a meta-search blend.

kd.description: Keyword difficulty 0–100; null without authority data or with fewer than 5 results.

provider.description: Provider that fetched the page, e.g. `serp_searxng`.

refresh.description: Fetch a fresh page instead of a cached one (cached pages are reused for 7 days).

sr.description:
SeoSeo Rank of the domain (0–100); null when it is outside the imported list or
no authority data is loaded.

invite_token.description: Token from an invitation link: joins that workspace even when sign-up is closed.

needs_setup.description: True when no account exists yet: the next sign-up becomes the instance admin.

delay_ms.description: Delay between requests per slot in ms (0–10000, default 250).

lighthouse.description: Run desktop Lighthouse lab audits (requires the renderer profile).

render_js.description: Audit the rendered DOM (requires the renderer profile).

respect_robots.description: Obey robots.txt (default true). Turn off only for sites you own.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; defaults to the project's market.

language.description: ISO 639-1; defaults to the project's market.

serp_top.description: Most popular ideas that also get a SERP analysis (0–30, default 10).

UpdateProjectInput.description: Partial update. Send `null` for nullable fields to clear them; omit to keep.

api_key.description: New API key. Send an empty string to remove the stored key; omit to keep it.

tags.name: providers
tags.description: Data providers, API keys and domain authority

tags.name: keywords
tags.description: Keyword research, saved keywords and SERP analysis
